60 /********************************************************************************/
    61
    62 #include "Tpm.h"
    63 #include "NV_DefineSpace_fp.h"
    64 #if CC_NV_DefineSpace  // Conditional expansion of this file
    65 TPM_RC
    66 TPM2_NV_DefineSpace(
    67              NV_DefineSpace_In   *in             // IN: input parameter list
    68              )
    69 {
    70     TPMA_NV         attributes = in->publicInfo.nvPublic.attributes;
    71     UINT16          nameSize;
    72     nameSize = CryptHashGetDigestSize(in->publicInfo.nvPublic.nameAlg);
    73     // Input Validation
    74     // Checks not specific to type
    75     // If the UndefineSpaceSpecial command is not implemented, then can't have
    76     // an index that can only be deleted with policy
    77 #if CC_NV_UndefineSpaceSpecial == NO
    78     if(IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, POLICY_DELETE))
    79  return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
    80 #endif
    81     // check that the authPolicy consistent with hash algorithm
    82     if(in->publicInfo.nvPublic.authPolicy.t.size != 0
    83        && in->publicInfo.nvPublic.authPolicy.t.size != nameSize)
    84  return TPM_RCS_SIZE + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
    85     // make sure that the authValue is not too large
    86     if(MemoryRemoveTrailingZeros(&in->auth)
    87        > CryptHashGetDigestSize(in->publicInfo.nvPublic.nameAlg))
    88  return TPM_RCS_SIZE + RC_NV_DefineSpace_auth;
    89     // If an index is being created by the owner and shEnable is
    90     // clear, then we would not reach this point because ownerAuth
    91     // can't be given when shEnable is CLEAR. However, if phEnable
    92     // is SET but phEnableNV is CLEAR, we have to check here
    93     if(in->authHandle == TPM_RH_PLATFORM && gc.phEnableNV == CLEAR)
    94  return TPM_RCS_HIERARCHY + RC_NV_DefineSpace_authHandle;
    95     // Attribute checks
    96     // Eliminate the unsupported types
    97     switch(GET_TPM_NT(attributes))
    98  {
    99 #if CC_NV_Increment == YES
   100    case TPM_NT_COUNTER:
   101 #endif
   102 #if CC_NV_SetBits == YES
   103    case TPM_NT_BITS:
   104 #endif
   105 #if CC_NV_Extend == YES
   106    case TPM_NT_EXTEND:
   107 #endif
   108 #if CC_PolicySecret == YES && defined TPM_NT_PIN_PASS
   109    case TPM_NT_PIN_PASS:
   110    case TPM_NT_PIN_FAIL:
   111 #endif
   112    case TPM_NT_ORDINARY:
   113      break;
   114    default:
   115      return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   116      break;
   117  }
   118     // Check that the sizes are OK based on the type
   119     switch(GET_TPM_NT(attributes))
   120  {
   121    case TPM_NT_ORDINARY:
   122      // Can't exceed the allowed size for the implementation
   123      if(in->publicInfo.nvPublic.dataSize > MAX_NV_INDEX_SIZE)
   124          return TPM_RCS_SIZE + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   125      break;
   126    case TPM_NT_EXTEND:
   127      if(in->publicInfo.nvPublic.dataSize != nameSize)
   128          return TPM_RCS_SIZE + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   129      break;
   130    default:
   131      // Everything else needs a size of 8
   132      if(in->publicInfo.nvPublic.dataSize != 8)
   133          return TPM_RCS_SIZE + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   134      break;
   135  }
   136     // Handle other specifics
   137     switch(GET_TPM_NT(attributes))
   138  {
   139    case TPM_NT_COUNTER:
   140      // Counter can't have TPMA_NV_CLEAR_STCLEAR SET (don't clear counters)
   141      if(IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, CLEAR_STCLEAR))
   142          return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   143      break;
   144 #ifdef TPM_NT_PIN_FAIL
   145    case TPM_NT_PIN_FAIL:
   146      // NV_NO_DA must be SET and AUTHWRITE must be CLEAR
   147      // NOTE: As with a PIN_PASS index, the authValue of the index is not
   148      // available until the index is written. If AUTHWRITE is the only way to
   149      // write then index, it could never be written. Rather than go through
   150      // all of the other possible ways to write the Index, it is simply
   151      // prohibited to write the index with the authValue. Other checks
   152      // below will insure that there seems to be a way to write the index
   153      // (i.e., with platform authorization , owner authorization,
   154      // or with policyAuth.)
   155      // It is not allowed to create a PIN Index that can't be modified.
   156      if(!IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, NO_DA))
   157          return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   158             /* fall through */
   159 #endif
   160 #ifdef TPM_NT_PIN_PASS
   161    case TPM_NT_PIN_PASS:
   162      // AUTHWRITE must be CLEAR (see note above to TPM_NT_PIN_FAIL)
   163      if(IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, AUTHWRITE)
   164         || IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, GLOBALLOCK)
   165         || IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, WRITEDEFINE))
   166          return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   167 #endif  // this comes before break because PIN_FAIL falls through
   168      break;
   169    default:
   170      break;
   171  }
   172     // Locks may not be SET and written cannot be SET
   173     if(IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, WRITTEN)
   174        || IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, WRITELOCKED)
   175        || IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, READLOCKED))
   176  return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   177     // There must be a way to read the index.
   178     if(!IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, OWNERREAD)
   179        && !IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, PPREAD)
   180        && !IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, AUTHREAD)
   181        && !IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, POLICYREAD))
   182  return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   183     // There must be a way to write the index
   184     if(!IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, OWNERWRITE)
   185        && !IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, PPWRITE)
   186        && !IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, AUTHWRITE)
   187        && !IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, POLICYWRITE))
   188  return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   189     // An index with TPMA_NV_CLEAR_STCLEAR can't have TPMA_NV_WRITEDEFINE SET
   190     if(IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, CLEAR_STCLEAR)
   191        &&  IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, WRITEDEFINE))
   192  return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   193     // Make sure that the creator of the index can delete the index
   194     if((IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, PLATFORMCREATE)
   195  && in->authHandle == TPM_RH_OWNER)
   196        || (!IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, PLATFORMCREATE)
   197     && in->authHandle == TPM_RH_PLATFORM))
   198  return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_authHandle;
   199     // If TPMA_NV_POLICY_DELETE is SET, then the index must be defined by
   200     // the platform
   201     if(IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, POLICY_DELETE)
   202        &&  TPM_RH_PLATFORM != in->authHandle)
   203  return TPM_RCS_ATTRIBUTES + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   204     // Make sure that the TPMA_NV_WRITEALL is not set if the index size is larger
   205     // than the allowed NV buffer size.
   206     if(in->publicInfo.nvPublic.dataSize > MAX_NV_BUFFER_SIZE
   207        &&  IS_ATTRIBUTE(attributes, TPMA_NV, WRITEALL))
   208  return TPM_RCS_SIZE + RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo;
   209     // And finally, see if the index is already defined.
   210     if(NvIndexIsDefined(in->publicInfo.nvPublic.nvIndex))
   211  return TPM_RC_NV_DEFINED;
   212     // Internal Data Update
   213     // define the space.  A TPM_RC_NV_SPACE error may be returned at this point
   214     return NvDefineIndex(&in->publicInfo.nvPublic, &in->auth);
   215 }
   216 #endif // CC_NV_DefineSpace
   217 #include "Tpm.h"
   218 #include "NV_UndefineSpace_fp.h"
   219 #if CC_NV_UndefineSpace  // Conditional expansion of this file
   220 TPM_RC

    64 #ifndef NV_DEFINESPACE_FP_H
    65 #define NV_DEFINESPACE_FP_H
    66
    67 typedef struct {
    68     TPMI_RH_PROVISION authHandle;
    69     TPM2B_AUTH      auth;
    70     TPM2B_NV_PUBLIC publicInfo;
    71 } NV_DefineSpace_In;
    72
    73 #define RC_NV_DefineSpace_authHandle     (TPM_RC_H + TPM_RC_1)
    74 #define RC_NV_DefineSpace_auth   (TPM_RC_P + TPM_RC_1)
    75 #define RC_NV_DefineSpace_publicInfo     (TPM_RC_P + TPM_RC_2)
2346:#define TPMA_NV_OWNERWRITE      ((TPMA_NV)1 << 1)
2347:#define TPMA_NV_AUTHWRITE       ((TPMA_NV)1 << 2)
2358:#define TPMA_NV_OWNERREAD       ((TPMA_NV)1 << 17)
2359:#define TPMA_NV_AUTHREAD        ((TPMA_NV)1 << 18)
2366:#define TPMA_NV_PLATFORMCREATE  ((TPMA_NV)1 << 30)
